intro: Bingles' Hammer is an engineering tool belonging to Bingles Blastenheimer, an eccentric gnome aviator stranded in Loch Modan. After crashing his flying machine into the Loch, hostile troggs scavenged the hammer along with his other specialized gear. Bingles needs it recovered so he can repair his aircraft and aid the war effort to liberate Gnomeregan.

p: When pilot Bingles Blastenheimer plunged into the waters of the Loch, his survival was only the first of his troubles. Troggs inhabiting the freshwater islands quickly raided the crash site, looting his specialized toolkit and high-potency explosives. Among the pilfered gear was his hammer, an indispensable implement for repairing the dented airframe and recalibrating the gyrocopter's mechanical assemblies. Without this essential tool and the rest of his equipment, Bingles remains thoroughly grounded, unable to fly support runs for the gnome liberation forces struggling to reclaim Gnomeregan.
